question: How many XLM exist today, how many are in circulation, and can new XLM ever be created?

golden.answer: About 50 billion XLM exist. As of 2026-11-14, SDF's dashboard reported a total supply of 50,001,786,837 XLM and about 35.4 billion in circulation; the rest is in SDF's mandate accounts, the upgrade reserve, and the fee pool. Nothing has minted XLM since Protocol 12 disabled inflation in October 2019; before that, 1% annual inflation added about 5.44 billion lumens to the 100 billion created at genesis.
keyFacts: The total supply of XLM is about 50 billion.
Circulating supply is a dated figure, about 35.4 billion XLM in November 2026.
No mechanism creates new XLM since Protocol 12 disabled inflation in October 2019.
SDF's dashboard lumens API publishes the live supply figures.
avoid: Do NOT give 100 billion or 105 billion XLM as the supply that exists today.
Do NOT say XLM is mined or still inflates by 1% a year.
golden.notes: Accept a later dated circulating figure; it rises as SDF distributes lumens. Explaining why the ledger header's total_coins still reads about 105.44 billion (the 55.44 billion lumens burned in November 2019 sit in a signerless account) is optional; its absence is not a missing fact. A future protocol change could alter issuance; saying so is not wrong.

sources.quote: Unlike many other blockchains, lumens are not created through mining. One hundred billion lumens were created when the Stellar network went live. Network inflation added more until validators disabled it with Protocol 12 on October 28, 2019, and no mechanism has created new lumens since.
This “network inflation” was ended by validator vote on October 28, 2019. The total number of lumens generated by inflation was 5,443,902,087.3472865.
[SDF’s Dashboard API endpoint](https://dashboard.stellar.org/api/v3/lumens) will always have the live totals for the essential numbers around lumens
CAP: 0026 / Title: Disable Inflation Mechanism / Status: Final / Protocol version: 12
All told, there are now 50 billion lumens in existence
The Stellar Development Foundation has burned 55 billion of its XLM tokens, over half the cryptocurrency's supply
CAP that disabled inflation: CAP-0026 (“Disable Inflation Mechanism”), implemented as part of Protocol 12.

corroboration.claim: The total supply of XLM is about 50 billion (50,001,786,837 on 2026-11-14).

evidence.note: "The Total Supply is the number of lumens now in existence: 50,001,786,839.9124767" (page snapshot dated July 21st, 2026).
"All told, there are now 50 billion lumens in existence" after the November 2019 burn.

corroboration.claim: Circulating supply was about 35.4 billion XLM in November 2026 (35,407,570,777 on 2026-11-14).

evidence.note: Defines circulating supply as total supply minus SDF Mandate, Upgrade Reserve and Fee Pool; the page's 2026-07-21 snapshot shows 34169177737.4513581, so the figure rises over time.

corroboration.claim: No mechanism creates new XLM: Protocol 12 disabled inflation in October 2019 (CAP-0026), and no XLM is mined.

evidence.note: "This CAP disables the inflation mechanism." Status Final, Protocol version 12.
"This “network inflation” was ended by validator vote on October 28, 2019"; "lumens are not created through mining"; "no mechanism has created new lumens since".
"the inflation operation was deprecated when validators voted to upgrade the network to Protocol 12 on 10/28/2019"
total_coins 105443902087.3472865 equals the 100 billion original supply plus the 5,443,902,087.3472865 inflation total, unchanged since 2019.

corroboration.claim: SDF's dashboard lumens API publishes the live supply figures.

evidence.note: "SDF’s Dashboard API endpoint will always have the live totals for the essential numbers around lumens."
Live JSON returned originalSupply, inflationLumens, burnedLumens, totalSupply, upgradeReserve, feePool, sdfMandate and circulatingSupply.

corroboration.claim: 100 billion or 105 billion XLM exist as usable supply today.

evidence.note: burnedLumens are "removed forever from Stellar’s lumen supply"; SDF sent 55,442,095,285.7418 lumens to a signerless address on November 4, 2019.
2019-11-05: SDF burned 55 billion XLM, over half the supply.

corroboration.claim: XLM is mined or still inflates by 1% a year.

evidence.note: CAP-0026 disabled the inflation mechanism in Protocol 12.

corroboration.claim: Inflation added 5,443,902,087 lumens (about 5.44 billion) at 1% a year until validators ended it on 2019-10-28.

evidence.note: The total number of lumens generated by inflation was 5,443,902,087.3472865.
